question: National Highway 48 (NH48) extends from:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi to Chennai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Highway 48 (NH48)** extends from **Delhi** to **Chennai**.
 
• It is one of the major highways in India, covering a vast distance and connecting important cities.
 
• NH48 is part of the Golden Quadrilateral project, which aims to connect the four major metro cities of India.
 
• This highway plays a crucial role in facilitating trade, commerce, and travel between the northern and southern parts of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Golden Quadrilateral project was initiated by the Government of India to improve the road infrastructure and enhance connectivity.
 
• NH48 passes through several states, including Haryana, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu.
 
• The highway supports a high volume of traffic and is crucial for the movement of goods and passengers.
 
• It also connects various industrial and economic hubs, contributing significantly to the country's economy.
